svg.aria-label: Sunny's pocket: a delegated allowance with on-chain guardrails
svg.text: Pocket money = a delegated allowance with on-chain guardrails
You fund it and set the rules. Sunny can spend it. A Solana program checks every payment, not the AI.

g.text: anything bigger is refused, however it’s asked
resets every day at midnight UTC
it can’t send your money anywhere else
one tap, your password, your call

svg.text: the AI agent, with its own key
Someone talks Sunny into “urgent, take $500 now”
Sunny tries, as built to. The program refuses (error 6003, on-chain). The money never moves.
